reports.notes: Launched from Mac Steam, the game exits after about 3 s. It is a console-subsystem program (.NET NativeAOT), and Hadron's Steam launcher started it without a console, so setting the console title failed.
reports.followUp: Fixed by Hadron pull request #185, which gives a console game a console of its own; expected in the next release.
